record.reason: HGMEM represents RAG working memory as a hypergraph whose hyperedges link facts and thoughts for multi-step relational reasoning over long contexts; it targets reasoning quality in retrieval pipelines, not inference efficiency or serving.
record.title: HGMEM: Hypergraph-based Working Memory to Improve Multi-step RAG for Long-Context Complex Relational Modeling
